name: IntelliJ IDEA
description_en:
IntelliJ IDEA is a product in the IDEs category. Its directory profile covers Refactoring, Syntax Highlighting, Code Completion, Real-time Collaboration, Debugger, Source code editor, Chat (Messaging), Drag and Drop.

Additional listed capabilities include Version Control. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Desktop App (Windows, Mac). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers Individuals. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $41.0.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: suggest code while it is being written; exchange messages within the supported workspace; move items directly through a visual interface; track changes to files and support revision workflows. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
IntelliJ IDEA 属于集成开发环境软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括代码重构、语法高亮、代码补全、实时协作、调试器、源代码编辑器、聊天消息、拖放操作。

资料还列出版本控制。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为桌面应用 (Windows, Mac)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 自由职业者 个人用户。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $41.0.。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：在编写过程中提供代码补全建议；在受支持的工作空间中交换消息；通过可视化界面直接拖放内容项；跟踪文件变更并支持版本修订流程。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
